UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Represents a user account within the Power Brain application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user account.

registrationDate.description: Date and time when the user registered.

lastLogin.description: Date and time of the user's last login.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents the profile information of a user.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user profile.

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth of the user.

profilePicture.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

gradeLevel.description: Grade level of the user (e.g., Form 1, Std 8).

studyStreaks.description: Number of consecutive days the user has studied.

totalTimeStudied.description: Total time in minutes the user has studied.

quizzesCompleted.description: Total number of quizzes the user has completed.

topicsMastered.description: Total number of topics the user has mastered.

badges.description: A list of badges the user has earned.

averageScore.description: The user's average score across all quizzes.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Represents a user's public entry on the leaderboard.

id.description: Unique identifier for the leaderboard entry (matches user ID).

averageScore.description: The user's average score across all quizzes.

profilePicture.description: URL to the user's profile picture, if available.

userAccounts/{userId}.description: Stores user account information. Uses path-based ownership for security. Includes standard user profile information such as email, username, registration date and last login.

userProfiles/{profileId}.description: Stores user profile details. Uses document id for security (profileId field from UserAccount). Includes user's personal information like first name, last name, date of birth, profile picture, grade level, and school ID.

leaderboard/{userId}.description: Stores public, denormalized data for the leaderboard. This collection is publicly readable for the leaderboard feature but write access is restricted.
